column1: # target: Pokémon Legends: Arceus v262144 climbable cliff surfaces (main areas 00..=06)
# note: derived from the real terrain heightmaps (archive/field/terrain/ha_areaNN.gfpak) with the decoded
# note: ride-Sneasler rule (data/ride_params.tsv ride_nyuura_config, values VERIFIED): lower limit 45 deg,
# note: start border 50 deg, upper limit 150 deg. A 1 m scan cell is climb-startable at slope in [50, 150] deg
# note: from horizontal (the start-border reading is PROBABLE; heights fields cannot exceed 90 deg).
# note: patches are budget-limited connected groups (default <= 120 cells); base_* is the lowest scan cell
# note: (the foot of the cliff); top_x/top_z is the highest scan cell (the crest). The avatar holds
# note: base_xz while climbing and steps off at top_xz (port mapping of a slope into a climb, ASSUMED).
# note: radius_m is the horizontal grab reach from the base (2..6 m). Filter: height >= 2 m, cells >= 6.
